about_event:
🌱 SUSTAINVERSE 2K26 – A 24-Hour Hackathon for a Sustainable Tomorrow

DMI College of Engineering, Chennai, proudly presents SUSTAINVERSE 2K26, organized by the Department of Artificial Intelligence & Data Science.

SUSTAINVERSE 2K26 challenges students to PLAN • INNOVATE • SUSTAIN by creating technology-driven solutions for real-world problems aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

Hackathon Themes:

• AI & ML

• Education

• Healthcare

• Cybersecurity

• Open Innovation

The hackathon follows a two-stage process.

ROUND 1 – REGISTRATION & IDEA SHORTLISTING

All participating teams must submit their preliminary idea through the Round 1 registration process. The submitted problem statement, proposed solution, and presentation will be evaluated for preliminary shortlisting.

Only 30 teams will be shortlisted for the final 24-hour hackathon.

Round 1 evaluation criteria:

• Uniqueness

• Novelty

• Innovation

• Problem Relevance

• SDG Alignment

• Feasibility

• Potential Impact

Teams are required to prepare and submit their presentation using the official SUSTAINVERSE 2K26 Round 1 PPT template.

IMPORTANT:

The Problem Statement and Idea submitted during Round 1 are only for the shortlisting process. They do not lock your team into the same problem or idea for the final hackathon. Shortlisted teams may refine, change, or choose a different problem or idea during the final 24-hour hackathon.

FINAL ROUND – 24-HOUR HACKATHON

The shortlisted 30 teams will participate in the final 24-hour offline hackathon at DMI College of Engineering.

Participants will collaborate, build prototypes, develop innovative solutions, and compete to create meaningful real-world impact.

Hackathon Details:

Date: September 15–16, 2026

Duration: 24 Hours

Venue: DMI College of Engineering, Chennai
